title: Fantastic Fireworks
description: This project adds fireworks that are perfect for any server wide events or just something fun to mess around with.
body:
# Fantastic Fireworks 

This mod adds one new block the firework cake which shoots out fully customizable fireworks. These fireworks are much more realistic than the minecraft fireworks thanks to the library loadstone. The gui that acompanys each block allows you to change the colors, gravity, and more for each part of the firework. The gui is made with ImGuiMC which I highly recomend.

## How To Setup Your First Fireworks
1. Start by shift right clicking any Firework Cake block.

2. Press f7 on your keyboard to open the customization gui.

3. Choose colors and attributes for your firework.

4. Right click or activate with redstone to watch your firework.
